Tina — thanks for sending this over and for the note. Quick replies below, and I've pulled in Kimberly (contracts), Marissa (sales ops) and Jonas (security) to help with the evidence and SLA items.

1) Data residency & KMS: Redwood supports hosted and Dedicated regions in us-west-2 / us-east-1 today. For Private deployments we support customer-managed KMS (AWS KMS / external HSM) — Jonas will confirm exact steps for key wrapping and attestations.

2) SLA baseline: Our standard SLA for Hosted API is 99.9% with a credit schedule; Dedicated/Private can be negotiated in reserved capacity contracts. Kimberly — can you confirm whether a 45-day credit window is something we can support in a standard SOW or if that requires an exceptions review?

3) Contracting and security contacts:
- Contracting owner: Kimberly Park, Senior Counsel (kimberly_park@redwood.ai)
- Security evidence: Jonas Weber, Director of Security (jonas_weber@redwood.ai)

Next steps I'm proposing:
- Kimberly to do an initial intake and flag any terms that will need legal redlines.

- We'll prepare an initial comment set on your MSA and aim to send Redwood_MSA_comments_v1.docx before the 7/14 call.

Priyom / team — I've completed a quick triage of the attached MSA. High-level notes (initial, not exhaustive):

- Liability / Cap: KeenHealth's draft asset-based liability carveouts exceed our standard cap. We'll propose keeping cap at 3x fees or $5M — Kimberly to draft proposed language.
- Data processing / PHI: Need to confirm whether KeenHealth intends to send PHI through Hosted API or will pursue Dedicated/Private. If PHI goes to Hosted we will need a Data Processing Addendum and additional controls documented; for Dedicated/Private the controls are covered in the SOW and infra addendum.
- SLA credit term: 45-day credit window is unusually long; standard is 30 days from incident report. Will escalate exceptions if required by customer.
- IP / feedback: propose redline to keep standard Redwood IP assignment and a limited feedback license.

I'll prepare a short comment set and the first-pass redline (Redwood_MSA_comments_v1.docx) by EOD 7/10. Jonas — can you upload SOC2 summary and pen test executive memo so we can share with the customer?

Regards,
Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference
